Form 51 — Voucher
Estimated Payment of Individual Income Tax
General Information
Use this form to:
• Calculate any payment due for a valid tax year 2025
extension.
• Make estimated payments for tax year 2026 (check the
appropriate year on the voucher below).
• Make payments of Qualified Investment Exemption (QIE)
recapture when you don’t file your income tax return by
the due date. Write “Payment of QIE Recapture” at the
bottom of the voucher below, and return it with a check.
About payments for extensions. If you can’t file your
2025 Idaho tax return by April 15, 2026, you qualify for an

automatic extension to file, if you pay at least one of these:
• 100% of the income tax on your 2024 return (if you filed).
You can’t use this method if you’ve never filed in Idaho.
• 80% of the estimated tax due on your 2025 return.
Complete the worksheet below to calculate payment due
for the filing extension. You must pay that amount online or
postmark it by April 15, 2026. If it’s $50 or less, you don’t have
to pay it now to get the extension.
There’s no extension for paying. We must charge interest on
any tax due that you don’t pay by April 15, 2026.
If you qualify for the extension, file and pay by October 15,
2026. Penalties can apply. See: tax.idaho.gov/extensions.

Tax Payment Worksheet. (Keep for your records.)

Form 43, lines 43 through 46, 63, 64, and 69 .....................................................................................................

The amount on line 11 is the minimum you must pay to get a valid filing extension. On line 12, enter any more
you want to pay now to reduce tax you owe, and the interest it will accrue.
12. Additional amount ............................................................................................................................................... 12.
13. Total. Add lines 11 and 12. Enter the amount here and on Form 51 below ........................................................ 13.
Return just the voucher below, and only if you’re making a payment.
